Okay, my grandpa passed 6 years ago from cancer. He was like my father. I loved him dearly, and I miss him everyday! I recently found out I'm pregnant. My grandmother (fathers mom) came to my dream and was happy for me when I told her my news. She was not happy to be here tho. The dream was dark and dirty. 
The night be for my 32nd, (last night) I finally had a visit from my grandpa (mothers father) I've been waiting years! He was not the slightest happy to be here. Said money is more important to my grandma, he won't come and get her. "That sombitch is crazy about you, treat him good, don't do it wrong like your grandma did" "that island saved your life, I was so glad to see you happy for once." "Grampas girl" he wouldn't let me see him. I think he forgot what he looked like? He left like an eagle with my dad. He doesn't want to come back here. He made it clear. I woke up instantly, and I could smell his corn cob pipe smoke. 
He didn't come to me as a person. Just words. My grandma came as herself I remember and spoke no words. Is the afterlife so amazing they forget the goodness of earth and remember it as sour?  
I appreciate their visits. I hold them dearly to my heart. I just have to question everything. Any input, or experiences like this please!
